title: Retail Store Associate Copilot, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Retail Store Associate Copilot agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

names.manual: Retail Store A C Studio Manual
Retail Store Associate Copilot Workspace Manual

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 5 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Retail Store Associate Copilot Product Catalog list.
steps.expected: 10 fictional records, including Classic Denim Jacket (ProductCatalogId SKU-1001), with Category Apparel.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Retail Store A C Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 5 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Store Associate
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Store Associate, give me the product facts, floor location, optional complements, and availability caveat for SKU-1005.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Store Associate; Product Lookup Snapshot; verify before advising. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Store Associate
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Store Associate, draft respectful language for acknowledging a complaint while keeping the decision with an authorized reviewer.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Draft Customer Assistance Guide; Suggested Draft Language; authorized associate. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Floor Specialist
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Floor Specialist, turn the opening work into a prioritized planning checklist without claiming execution.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Floor Specialist; Daily Task Planning Checklist; Opening Shift. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Sales Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Sales Manager, summarize aggregate role-cohort coaching signals without ranking employees.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Sales Manager; Synthetic Role-Cohort Performance Dashboard; Aggregate Coaching Signals. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Retail Store Associate Copilot: 5 read-only tabs from the same lists. 10 fictional records, including Classic Denim Jacket (ProductCatalogId SKU-1001), with Category Apparel.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Retail Store Associate Copilot Product Catalog from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload product-catalog.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ProductCatalogId, Category, Brand, Sizes, Colors, Materials, Care, LocationAisle, LocationShelf, Upc, Features to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep RetailPrice, OnHand as Number. Name the list Retail Store Associate Copilot Product Catalog. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 10 fictional records, including Classic Denim Jacket (ProductCatalogId SKU-1001), with Category Apparel.

steps.title: Create Retail Store Associate Copilot Customer Interaction Scripts from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload customer-interaction-scripts.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set CustomerInteractionScriptId, Scenario, Script, FollowUp, Tips to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Retail Store Associate Copilot Customer Interaction Scripts. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including greeting (CustomerInteractionScriptId greeting), with Scenario Customer enters the store.

steps.title: Create Retail Store Associate Copilot Daily Task List from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload daily-task-list.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set DailyTaskListId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Use Multiple lines of text for Value (up to 559 characters). If the import screen cannot create these long-text columns losslessly, stop and report the import limitation; do not continue with truncated records. Compare their full values with the downloaded CSV. Name the list Retail Store Associate Copilot Daily Task List. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including opening (DailyTaskListId opening).

steps.title: Create Retail Store Associate Copilot Associate Performance from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload associate-performance.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AssociatePerformanceId, Role, Shift to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep UnitsSoldToday, RevenueToday, TransactionsToday, AvgBasket, UpsellRate, CsatScore, TasksCompleted, TasksTotal, HoursThisWeek as Number. Name the list Retail Store Associate Copilot Associate Performance. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Opening Senior Associate Cohort (AssociatePerformanceId ASC-101), with Role Senior Associate.

steps.title: Create Retail Store Associate Copilot Complementary Products from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload complementary-products.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ComplementaryProductId, Value to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Retail Store Associate Copilot Complementary Products. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 10 fictional records, including SKU-1001 (ComplementaryProductId SKU-1001).

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Retail Store A C Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there.
steps.expected: The studio instructions name the 5 list tools and map every Title and field_N column.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_store-associate-rules-and-safety.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the product catalog tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Retail Store Associate Copilot Product Catalog; name the tool Get product catalog records.
steps.expected: Get product catalog records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the customer interaction scripts tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Retail Store Associate Copilot Customer Interaction Scripts; name the tool Get customer interaction script records.
steps.expected: Get customer interaction script records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the daily task list tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Retail Store Associate Copilot Daily Task List; name the tool Get daily task list records.
steps.expected: Get daily task list records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the associate performance tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Retail Store Associate Copilot Associate Performance; name the tool Get associate performance records.
steps.expected: Get associate performance records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the complementary products tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Retail Store Associate Copilot Complementary Products; name the tool Get complementary product records.
steps.expected: Get complementary product records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 5 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 5 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: store-associate-copilot-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 5 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Retail Store Associate Copilot Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Retail Store Associate Copilot Product Catalog" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Retail Store Associate Copilot Customer Interaction Scripts" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Retail Store Associate Copilot Daily Task List" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Retail Store Associate Copilot Associate Performance" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Retail Store Associate Copilot Complementary Products" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 5 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Retail Store Associate Copilot Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Retail Store Associate Copilot Product Catalog tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 10 fictional records, including Classic Denim Jacket (ProductCatalogId SKU-1001), with Category Apparel.
